item.title: Sui Adds NIST-Approved Quantum Security to Future-Proof Blockchain
item.summary: Sui has introduced a major security upgrade by integrating two quantum-resistant digital signature schemes approved by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), strengthening the blockchain’s defenses against the potential risks posed by future advances in quantum computing.
